about.title: Hemet Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A recalled space heater in a Hemet living room. A tire that came apart on Sanderson Avenue. A ladder that folded on a job off State Street. When an everyday product fails and someone gets hurt, California law treats the case differently than an ordinary accident. Under strict liability, you generally do not have to prove the company was careless. You need to show the product had a defect — in its design, in how that particular unit was made, or in the warnings that came with it — and that the defect caused your injury. Riverside County juries hear these cases, and the responsible parties can include the manufacturer, the distributor, and the store in Hemet that sold the item. We work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. Hold on to the product. It is often the most important evidence you have.

whyChoose.title: How We Can Help With Your Product Liability Claim in Hemet

items.title: Strict liability works in your favor
items.desc: In most California product cases, you do not have to prove the manufacturer was negligent. We focus on showing the design, manufacturing, or warning defect and linking it to your injury.

items.title: More than one company may owe you
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and the Hemet retailer that sold the product can all share responsibility. We identify everyone in the chain so a claim is not aimed at the wrong party.

items.title: Evidence preservation from day one
items.desc: The defective item, its packaging, receipts, and photos matter enormously in these cases. We can arrange to secure and inspect the product before it is discarded or altered.

items.question: My airbag did not deploy in a crash on Florida Avenue. Is that a car accident case or a product case?
items.answer: It may be both. Hemet recorded 273 injury collisions in 2025, and in some of those, a vehicle component failure makes the injuries worse than the crash itself would have. If an airbag, seatbelt, or tire did not perform as designed, a strict liability claim against the manufacturer can run alongside any claim against the other driver. We can have the vehicle inspected before it is repaired or scrapped.

items.question: I threw away the product after I got hurt. Do I still have a claim?
items.answer: You may, though it becomes harder. Photos, the box, a receipt, the model number, or even the same product still sold at a Hemet store can help us reconstruct what failed. If any part of the item remains, stop using it and store it as-is. We can advise on what else may be recoverable.

items.question: Does contacting us cost anything, and do you charge upfront?
items.answer: No and no. There is no charge to contact us for a free case review. We handle product liability cases on contingency, meaning we are paid only if there is a recovery. You can ask about fee percentages during your first conversation.
